Repairs & Installations

The fixtures your customers, guests and tenants actually touch, from a single flush valve to a full refit.

Get a Quote Call 803-600-4357

What It Is

Restrooms, guest rooms, break rooms and kitchens are where people notice plumbing. We repair and install the fixtures in those spaces and the piping behind them.

Signs You Need It

  • Toilets or urinals that run or won't flush
  • Leaking faucets or broken sensors
  • Fixtures that look worn or outdated
  • A kitchen or restroom refit in the works

What To Expect

We take care of single repairs on a service call and plan larger refits with you. Work is scheduled around your hours, and we leave restrooms and kitchens clean and ready to use.

Commercial Services

What We Handle

  • Fixture Installs

    New sinks, faucets, toilets and urinals keep a building looking cared for. We install commercial fixtures and the valves and supply lines that go with them.

    What's included

    • Sink, faucet, toilet and urinal installation
    • New shutoff valves and supply lines
    • Drain and trap connections
    • Leak and function check

    Common signs you need this

    • Worn or broken fixtures
    • Updating restrooms or break rooms
    Get a Quote

  • Restroom Plumbing

    Customer and multi-floor restrooms take heavy use. We repair flush valves, sensors and drains so restrooms stay open and working.

    What's included

    • Flush valve and sensor repair
    • Clearing restroom drains
    • Replacing failed parts on toilets and urinals
    • Leak checks on every fixture we service

    Common signs you need this

    • Toilets or urinals that run or won't flush
    • Sensor faucets that don't respond
    • Restroom closed for repairs
    Get a Quote

  • Guest Room Fixtures

    Motels and hotels have dozens of identical fixtures, and small problems repeat down the hall. We handle in-room repairs room by room, scheduled around your occupancy.

    What's included

    • Tub and shower valve repair
    • Toilet and sink repairs
    • Fixture replacement
    • Work scheduled around occupancy

    Common signs you need this

    • Guest complaints about water temperature or drips
    • The same repair needed in several rooms
    Get a Quote

  • Back-of-House & Break Room Sinks

    Break rooms and back-of-house areas need sinks that hold up to daily use. We repair, replace and install them along with the drains behind them.

    What's included

    • Sink and faucet repair or replacement
    • Drain and trap service
    • New sink installation
    • Leak check

    Common signs you need this

    • Leaking or dripping sinks
    • Slow drains in staff areas
    Get a Quote

  • Kitchens & Fellowship Halls

    Commercial and church kitchens need prep sinks, hand sinks and connections that work every time they're used. We plumb and maintain them.

    What's included

    • Prep and hand sink installation
    • Dishwasher and equipment water connections
    • Drain line service
    • Fixture repairs

    Common signs you need this

    • Kitchen refit or new equipment
    • Sinks that leak or drain slowly
    Get a Quote
